activities.description: Narrator transitions to discussing the relationship between the plasma membrane and disease.
Narrator states that damage to membrane integrity can lead to various health problems.
Examples of membrane-related diseases are given, including hypercholesterolemia, diabetes, obesity, and Graves' disease.
The narrator explains how cell structural instability can cause red blood cell abnormalities and affect transport systems.
Cystic fibrosis is presented as a specific example of a disease caused by a mutation in a membrane protein.
